_about: Supabase's security advisor findings we have read and accept, each with why (ENGINEERING.md). scripts/advisors.mjs runs at every ship and fails on anything not listed. 'only' lists exact tables or functions; 'any' accepts the rule wherever it appears.

rls_enabled_no_policy.reason: Deny-all on purpose: these are written and read only through the SECURITY DEFINER functions below (quota, events, origins, owners, MCP counts, the tap map), never directly.

anon_security_definer_function_executabl.reason: note_mcp_call is how the public MCP server counts calls with the publishable key; it only adds one to a day's count for four known tool names, and stores nothing anyone sent.

authenticated_security_definer_function_.reason: Each acts only on the caller's own row or a count, with search_path pinned (selfcheck): ai_take (the daily AI quota), note_event and note_origin (outcome counts), note_mcp_call (as above); note_taps only adds counts for plain button and screen names, at most 50 a call and 2000 rows a day, with nothing that says who; owner_metrics raises 'not allowed' for anyone not in app_owners (checked in the migrations and live on 2026-11-11).

auth_allow_anonymous_sign_ins.reason: Trials are anonymous accounts by design ('Start now', no email); every policy they meet is own-rows, so a trial reads and writes only its own data (audited with a second account, 2026-07-28).

auth_leaked_password_protection.reason: Needs Supabase's Pro plan (checked 2026-11-11: 'available on Pro Plans and up'); the app stays free (decision 0001). Passwords are at least 8 characters.
